ticket.title: Screening field-set change — release 2
ticket.text: Release changes Screening field-set rule. Implementation date: 2026-12-01.

decisions.proposer_reason: Field-set defines required attributes screened; validation ensures those fields are present.
decisions.proposer_counter: No direct dependency edge visible, but functional link exists.
decisions.checker_reason: R03 (Screening field-set rule) is GOVERNED_BY I02 (Screening request interface) which sends payment‑party data to the Screening Engine; C012 (Required-field validation — daily completeness) is GOVERNED_BY S02 (Payment Validation Service) and belongs to the Required-field validation family, whose members are governed by the same validation service. The rule defines the required attributes for sanctions screening, and the validation control ensures those fields are present, forming a functional chain R03 → I02 → (screening process) ↔ S02 → C012.
